verdict.rationale: Reader's hosted proxy (`x-proxy: auto`, API key required) rotates residential and datacenter IPs and says it "handles common anti-bot challenges automatically" (gh-9). Login walls are handled only by passing session cookies through `X-Set-Cookie` (docs-1), which means the user must obtain those cookies, so it is not fully hands-off. Missing for 10: explicit CAPTCHA-solving evidence, automated login or form filling without user-supplied cookies, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the anti-bot handling works.
